title: Everdrone appoints Emil Granberg as new CTO
summary: Granberg has been part of Everdrone since its founding in 2017 and has played a central role in the development of the company’s drone platform.
body_markdown:
Everdrone has appointed Emil Granberg as its new chief technology officer (CTO).


Granberg has been part of Everdrone since its founding in 2017 and has played a central role in the development of the company’s drone platform.


“Appointing internally gives us a smooth transition and full continuity in our technology development. I look forward to working with Emil in his new role as the company moves into a commercial phase,” said Mats Sällström, CEO of Everdrone.


Granberg assumed the role of CTO in June 2026, succeeding Michael Öhman. Since joining Everdrone in 2017, Granberg has been responsible for the development of the company’s drone technology.


As CTO, Granberg leads a technical team of seven and has overall responsibility for Everdrone’s technology development across hardware, software and testing.


“We have gone from early prototypes to a complete system that is being used in real-world emergency response operations. We have built a strong technology platform, and the next step is to continue developing it for greater capacity, shorter response times and more applications within emergency medical care and other public services,” said Grunberg.


“At the same time, we will continue to strengthen our control across the entire technology chain, from cloud infrastructure and software to drones and manufacturing.”


Granberg succeeds Michael Öhman, who has served as CTO of Everdrone for four years. The handover to Granberg has taken place gradually since he assumed the role of CTO in June 2026.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Everdrone.*
